override_authority: pre-frozen release-profile-amendment.json; original R_matrix retained verbatim in protocol.json, server build explicitly replaced by release amendment

effective_R_matrix.source_configuration: 512KiB stripes/threshold, 512MiB slab, tier_a4 buffered pointer reads, application L1 bypass; no OS page cache flush

variants.R1: same binary, pool limit equals concurrency

effective_R_matrix.content: known index modulo 251 bytes; different object keys, not different content distributions
effective_R_matrix.pair_order: R0 then R1 on even block; R1 then R0 on odd block
effective_R_matrix.object_rotation: pair index modulo 3; both variants use the exact same frozen object identity
effective_R_matrix.primary_metric: ordinary median of all steady per-request read_multi_rail_into durations within a process, then geometric mean of paired R0/R1 ratios
effective_R_matrix.tail_metric: per-process nearest-rank p95 over steady request durations, then paired ratios; descriptive small-sample evidence, no p99 claim
effective_R_matrix.sensitivity: paired log-ratio t interval df9; record slower blocks; do not select a more favorable method after data
effective_R_matrix.timing_boundary: per-request timing excludes later pattern-hash validation; concurrent batch wall time and CPU include batch coordination and post-read validation, serial CPU has the existing narrower timed-read scope; do not conflate these across concurrency
effective_R_matrix.phase_diagnostics: separate tracing-enabled six-read processes per size and variant, concurrency1, first read vs next five; no tracing in primary matrix
acceptance: All scheduled slots present, no failure/outlier removal
all read sizes and full known-pattern hashes correct
initial/final descriptor and placement identity exact per object
R1 created <= concurrency, created+reused == all reads, no retirement/rejection, active/connecting/retiring zero at final; idle==live==created
source, binaries, server PID/startticks/config/env captured before and after
effective_R_matrix.adoption: Both optimizations remain opt-in regardless of result; no forced positive performance threshold or dual-HCA/inference claim
